title: ARG Intent-Bound Token Template
description: Template for minting ephemeral authorization scopes tied to purpose classification hashes. Ensures every token carries the intent that authorized it.

purpose_classification.description: Defines the authorized intent this template binds tokens to

classification_id.description: Unique identifier for this purpose classification

description.description: Human-readable description of the authorized purpose

appropriation_code.description: Cost center or appropriation code this token spend is authorized against. Solves the color of money problem.

semantic_boundary_hash.description: Hash of the semantic boundary defining what actions are in scope for this purpose

scope_constraints.description: Hard boundaries on what a token minted from this template can do

blocked_endpoint_patterns.description: Explicit block list. Takes precedence over allowed patterns.

max_downstream_depth.description: Maximum depth of child agent spawning permitted under this token

data_classification_ceiling.description: Maximum data sensitivity level this token may access

ttl_seconds.description: Token lifetime in seconds from minting. Token self-destructs after this window.
